title: Vergrim's Vacation
html:
Quest Giver: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Quest Type: Kill Boss

Quest Description: Kill Vergrim on level 7 of Vegrim's Vexation

Quest Reward: 15,000 Gold and 10 Kings Coins

Return to: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Vergrim in his Lair off of Level 7 of Vergrim's Vexation and Return to Skeer'ikt the Chirper in Vergrim's Vexation off of Level 1 in the Cavernous Cavern of Caves.

Offer:

Nows I thinks yous is ready for the biggests of tasks: Kill Vergrimses! Sissirats and Vergrimses do not likes each other and Sissirats wants Vergrimses dead, dead, dead! I could have killed hims myself, but nows that I am in this cage I kinds of wants to stay heres and live here. Its a fixers-uppers but I like to works with my claws and I've been lookings to move up to a deluxe cage appartment in the undergrounds.

Whens you are readys, go an kills Vergrimses in his Lair off of Level 7 of Vergrimses Vexation and returns to me, Skeer'ikt the Chirper, heres in the Cavernous Cavern of Caves when you are done. This will be the biggests fights or your life so I hopes you are prepared.

Turn-in:

Oh mys! You dids it! I almosts wants you tos kills me so I can have the honors of being killed by the Dungeons Runner that killed Vergrimses, but I don'ts wants to dies just yet. Here, have alls my candies! Alls of thems! Even the ones I keeps in my pouch!

Objectives:

  • Slain Vergrim

Level range: 15–30
